newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Omega Oil takes stake in Tunisia well.
newsitem.headline: Omega Oil takes stake in Tunisia well.

text.p: Omega Oil No Liability said on Thursday it had acquired an interest in the forthcoming Chott Fejaj-3 well and the Fejaj permit, located onshore in Tunisia.
Omega will acquire an initial 5.3 percent stake from the operator, Bligh Oil and Minerals, by contributing US$400,000 to the drilling cost of the Chott Fejaj-3 well.
Omega said its interest may increase if the proposed total well cost is below US$3.75 million or if it increases its contributions prior to commencement of the well.

"The Fejaj permit lies in the Ghafsa Trough in Central Tunisia, in an area of proven source and reservoir rock potential, characterised by complex structural geology, salt wall tectonics and wrench faulting," Omega said in a statement.
It said the block was traversed by established oil and gas pipeline facilities and sealed roads.
